description: Hybrid tests assess a six-storey steel-concrete building prototype with dissipative replaceable beam splices. Measurements cover damage-limitation, significant-damage and near-collapse states. Load cells, strain gauges, displacement transducers and inclinometers record response, providing evidence for evaluating replaceable connection details and the seismic performance of composite frames. The dataset is provided by University of Trento through BED. BED assigns the experiment to 2020. The provider metadata identifies compressed archives. BED displays download links with no stated charge. Actual file retrieval was not tested. The stated licence is CC BY 4.0. The measurements support calibration or checking of infrastructure response models. Sampling resolution is not established here unless stated above; file-level quality remains unverified.
